observations: Photo 0 shows a black PlayStation 4 console with two controllers on top: one white with a custom sticker design, the other green camouflage.
Photo 1 shows the same setup from a slightly different angle, with the same two controllers and console.
The console has 'PS4' branding visible on the front right side in photo 0 and photo 1.
The left side of the console in photo 1 shows 'SONY' branding.
The console appears to be a standard black PS4 model, not a slim or pro variant.
The controllers are visibly customized: one with a white base and stickers, the other with a green camouflage skin.
No games, cables, or power supply are visible in the photos.
The console surface shows some smudges and minor wear.

claims.claim: Uk used PS4 comes with 2 Controllers and 10 games inside working perfect
claims.evidence: The console and two controllers are visible in the photos, but no games are shown. The 'working perfect' claim cannot be verified remotely.

risks.risk: The console may not be functional or may have hardware issues (e.g., disc reader, power supply, or internal damage).
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and playing a game.

risks.risk: The 10 games mentioned are not visible and may not be included or may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: Photos of the 10 game cases or discs, or a video showing them being played.

risks.risk: The controllers may be damaged, non-functional, or have battery issues.
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers connecting to the console and responding to inputs.
risks.if_unproven: priced as controllers may not work

risks.risk: The console may be stolen or have a blacklisted serial number.
risks.proof: A photo of the serial number on the console's bottom or back, and a verification from Sony or a trusted reseller.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and playing a game.
Photos or video of the 10 games included.
Video showing both controllers connecting and working with the console.
Photo of the console's serial number.
response.reason: The console and controllers are visible and identifiable, but critical claims about functionality and included games cannot be verified from the photos alone. The item must be proven to work and the games must be shown before pricing can be determined.
